name: CaseTransformScaleZeroByAxis
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "transform-scale-zero-by-axis" (transform). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: transform: scale(0) on a child part at the default axis value, scale(1) on the other — the mui.radio `checked` shape (scale(0) IS the library's hide mechanism for the selection dot)
